summary: Server one-frame component holding the item-use events (esv::item::UseItemEvent) of the frame, put on one event entity by esv::item::UseSystem::SendEvents (the entity is destroyed when there are no events). Seen.py context: appears at most once at a time, in steps that use items (potion, dialogues and trigger events that interact with objects: doors, chests, explosions).

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x13BFF30 UseSystem::SendEvents builds each element (ls::IndexedStorage<esv::item::UseItemEvent>, stride 0x20) from the system's request (stride 0x20): +0 = 0 when the request's first byte is 0, 1 otherwise (use started / use finished or similar).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Qword copied from request +8 (an entity: item or user).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Qword copied from request +0x10 (an entity: item or user).

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: 1 by default; for Type 1 the byte at request +0x18.

fields.name: Events
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x13BFF30 esv::item::UseSystem::SendEvents fills a local DynamicArray<UseItemEvent> (stride 0x20) and moves it into the one-frame component added to the event entity (pointer +0, capacity +8, size +0xC). Live: 47 instances, heap pointer at +0, capacity 1-2 at +8, size 1-2 at +0xC.
